svg.text: Ulysses on a Gated MLA layer: the sharded axis swaps sequence for heads and back (one rank shown; cp ranks run this in lockstep)
T tokens, L = T/cp local tokens, H heads on this rank, G = H/cp, Q/N/V query, nope-key and value head dims, R rotary width, W = Q+N+V. Line numbers: sharding.py unless named.
Projections on the local sequence chunk (seq-sharded) -- model.py:131-135 branches here when a CP group is set
q [L, H, Q]
kv [L, H, N+V]
k_rope [L, R]
headless: one vector per token
pack q and kv along the channel dim -> [L, H, W]
one collective moves both (223)
all-to-all 1: sequence -> heads (156-165, called at 224-227)
view [L, H, W] as [cp, L, G, W], dim 0 = destination rank, then all_to_all_single
recv[s] = source s's L tokens for THIS rank's G heads; stack in source order
-> [T, G, W]: the full sequence for G heads
split -> q [T, G, Q] k_nope [T, G, N] v [T, G, V]
rotary key stays OUT of the all-to-all
packing the pre-expanded key would reassemble it against the wrong head subset
all-gather along the sequence (234-238)
dist_nn.all_gather of [L, R] over the cp group, concatenated on dim 0
expand onto the G local heads -> [T, G, R]; concat with k_nope -> k [T, G, N+R]
attention backend, unchanged, on the full sequence for this rank's G heads (249-255)
causal mask rebuilt for length T (full_sequence_causal_mask 176-196; a stream wider than the context window is rejected: a causal-only mask cannot see a document boundary)
-> out [T, G, V]
all-to-all 2: heads -> sequence (166-173, called at 256-259)
view [T, G, V] as [cp, L, G, V], dim 0 = destination sequence chunk, then all_to_all_single
out[s] = source s's head subset for THIS rank's L tokens; stack heads in source order
-> [L, H, V]: the layer's normal layout, back to wo and the gate (model.py:144-145)
Per layer: two all-to-alls on the packed q/kv, one all-gather on the rotary key. No other communication.
All three go through torch.distributed.nn.functional, so the backward is the transposed collective (all-to-all back, reduce-scatter for the gather).
The placement pair S(seq) <-> S(heads) is declared once as a contract (99-109); cp_all_to_all_headseq takes its dims from it (149-153), so a pair with no implementation raises.
n_heads % cp == 0 is checked at wiring time (parallelize.py:128-132). H is already TP-local: TP splits the heads first, Ulysses splits what TP left.
KDA layers do not take this path: their sequence stays sharded end to end (KCP, fla-core's CP ops), so the two mechanisms run at once on disjoint layer kinds.
